description: Rainbrand is a service for turning a brand’s identity, guidance, and assets into maintained, versioned context that agents and applications can use. It supports brand onboarding, task-specific briefs, generation workflows, review, and asset/library management.
summary: Rainbrand exposes two developer integration surfaces on its own domains: a REST API at https://www.rainbrand.com/api/v1 authenticated by API key or OAuth bearer token, and an OAuth-protected remote MCP server at https://mcp.rainbrand.com/mcp that self-onboards via DCR and also declares API-key header support.
